answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 931 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the island. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the onyx queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The quill index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 323 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
